_doc: tools/run_day_pipeline.py config (schema gymform.day_pipeline/v1). Reference set = D7v2 smoke t2 (the 2 GenerateVideo clips that passed G1-G8, 2026-11-03): pinned stills + contraction keyframes + clips. Copy this file per day; see docs/RUN_DAY_PIPELINE.md.
prompt_template: Seated cable row, done {form}: {action} Start and end exactly as in the first frame; reach the pinned contraction pose at the pinned times. One smooth rep, even tempo. Locked static camera, no zoom, no pan. Same matte charcoal-grey mannequin, same matte-black shorts, same low-row machine with matte cobalt weight plates and warm-grey frame in every frame; nothing appears or disappears. The {glow} glow stays exactly where and as large as in the pinned frames, on the {muscle} only. Flat, even, shadowless light; flat dark charcoal backdrop. No text, no logo.

prompt_vars.action: the arms yank the handle to the belly while the shoulders shrug up toward the ears.
chest up, shoulders down, the elbows drive straight back past the torso.
